div.div: Splunk Technology Add-on (TA) Architecture Note: NetSpout purposefully emits 100% schema-compliant vendor event formats without bundling dozens of 3rd-party TAs inside the application package. Bundling external TAs causes multi-gigabyte bloat and violates Splunk Cloud AppInspect vetting standards. To enable Common Information Model (CIM) field extractions for ingested events, install the appropriate vendor TA from Splunkbase (e.g. Splunk Add-on for Cisco Catalyst Center, Cisco SD-WAN Add-on, Palo Alto Networks Add-on). See the Help Guide for the full mapping directory.
